attributes.name: SpineRootJointName
attributes.helptext: The root joint of the chain to be modified, where the IK aim begins to take effect

attributes.name: GunJointName
attributes.helptext: The joint to which the gun mesh is attached.

attributes.name: GunBindJointName
attributes.helptext: The joint to which the stock of the gun is bound.  The transform of the stock of the gun will remain relative to the transform of the selected joint, moving the gun with it.  For example, bracing the stock of a rifle against the primary shoulder.

attributes.name: SecondaryWristJointName
attributes.helptext: The secondary wrist end joint in the chain to be modified.

attributes.name: PrimaryWristJointName
attributes.helptext: The primary wrist end joint of the chain to be modified.

attributes.name: GunPivotOffsetX
attributes.helptext: The offset from the Gun Joint to the position of the gun stock in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunPivotOffsetY
attributes.helptext: The offset from the Gun Joint to the position of the gun stock in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunPivotOffsetZ
attributes.helptext: The offset from the Gun Joint to the position of the gun stock in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunBarrelOffsetX
attributes.helptext: The offset from the Gun Joint to a point on the gun barrel in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunBarrelOffsetY
attributes.helptext: The offset from the Gun Joint to a point on the gun barrel in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunBarrelOffsetZ
attributes.helptext: The offset from the Gun Joint to a point on the gun barrel in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunPointingVectorX
attributes.helptext: The vector defining which direction the gun barrel is pointing in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunPointingVectorY
attributes.helptext: The vector defining which direction the gun barrel is pointing in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: GunPointingVectorZ
attributes.helptext: The vector defining which direction the gun barrel is pointing in the coordinate system of the gun.

attributes.name: SecondaryArmHingeAxisX
attributes.helptext: The vector defining the hinge axis for the secondary elbow, in the coordinate frame of the shoulder.

attributes.name: SecondaryArmHingeAxisY
attributes.helptext: The vector defining the hinge axis for the secondary elbow, in the coordinate frame of the shoulder.

attributes.name: SecondaryArmHingeAxisZ
attributes.helptext: The vector defining the hinge axis for the secondary elbow, in the coordinate frame of the shoulder.

attributes.name: PrimaryArmHingeAxisX
attributes.helptext: The vector defining the hinge axis for the primary elbow, in the coordinate frame of the shoulder.

attributes.name: PrimaryArmHingeAxisY
attributes.helptext: The vector defining the hinge axis for the primary elbow, in the coordinate frame of the shoulder.

attributes.name: PrimaryArmHingeAxisZ
attributes.helptext: The vector defining the hinge axis for the primary elbow, in the coordinate frame of the shoulder.

attributes.name: SpineBias
attributes.helptext: A float parameter between -1 and 1, defining the amount of weight given to each joint for achieving the goal. -1 is fully biased towards the root joint, 0 is an even spread, and 1 is fully biased towards the end joint.

attributes.name: FlipSecondaryHinge
attributes.helptext: If set, the sign of the mid joint axis of the secondary arm is changed, which will flip its bending direction.

attributes.name: FlipPrimaryHinge
attributes.helptext: If set, the sign of the mid joint axis of the primary arm is changed, which will flip its bending direction.

attributes.name: UpdateTargetByDeltas
attributes.helptext: If Previous is set, assume that the input target position was given relative to the character trajectory root at the previous update, and should be corrected for motion since then.

attributes.name: UseSecondaryArm
attributes.helptext: If set, the secondary arm is bound to the gun, otherwise it is free.  Use for two-handed guns.

attributes.name: KeepUpright
attributes.helptext:
Minimise tilt of the gun around the barrel direction.  This relies on the input animation providing an upright orientation as reference.

There will be a discontinuity between aiming around to the left or the right when the target passes behind the character.

attributes.name: ApplyJointLimits
attributes.helptext:
Enforce joint limits defined on your animation rig.

Only joint limits on the primary arm can prevent the character from successfully aiming at any target.

attributes.name: DebugDraw
attributes.helptext:
If set, then debug lines will be drawn in the viewport.

Yellow = Barrel position & Orientation, Red = Arm hinge axes, Cyan = Stock position, Green = Brace Joint

In the Preview Script an update handler will need to call viewport.debugDraw.update() to see the debug information.

attributes.name: WorldSpaceTarget
attributes.helptext: If true, the target input control parameter is specified in world space; otherwise, it is expressed in character space (the coordinate frame of the trajectory joint).

helptext: GunAimIK: points gun at target along a given pointing direction
